newsitem.title: SWEDEN: TENNIS-EDBERG PULLS OUT OF DAVIS CUP AND RETIRES.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-EDBERG PULLS OUT OF DAVIS CUP AND RETIRES.

text.p: Sweden's Stefan Edberg pulled out of the Davis Cup final on Sunday because of a twisted ankle.

Sunday's game against Arnaud Boetsch of France was to have been his last match before retiring from competitive tennis. Nicklas Kulti will take his place in the second reverse singles with the tie poised at 2-2, Davis Cup officials said.

Kulti alongside Jonas Bjorkman lost Sweden's doubles match on Saturday to give France a 2-1 lead, but Thomas Enqvist triumphed in a four-and-a-half hour duel 3-6 6-7 6-4 6-4 9-7 over Cedric Pioline to level the tie on Sunday.
Edberg, who announced his retirement a year ago, fell heavily during his loss against Pioline on Friday and limped throughout the rest of the encounter.
He rested his foot on Saturday and trained gently on Sunday but the ankle was swollen and had some ligament damamge.
